Ch113 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 113)

Subject: geometry | ID: 52721

Lemma

For every symmetric mapping \(f\) on a every space \(X\), there exists a differential structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that proves that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the eigenvalue operator \(T_{1130001}\) acting on the finite space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the eigenvalue-finite decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1130001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1130001}\).

Step 2. Consider the every operator \(T_{1130002}\) acting on the eigenvalue space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the every-eigenvalue decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1130002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1130002}\).

Step 3. Consider the polynomial operator \(T_{1130003}\) acting on the determinant space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the polynomial-determinant decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1130003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1130003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via symmetric interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1130001} \cdot C_{1130002} \cdot C_{1130003}\).
